script:
Script of the plant (plant): a potted plant that dries out: the person waters it or asks how it is
- move dry out: "The sun has been on me for a while; my soil dries out."; needs moist, sun; leaves dry.
- move water: "When I am dry and you water me, my soil is moist again."; needs dry, cmd water; leaves moist, done(water).
- move check moist: "When you check on me while I am moist, I tell you I am moist."; needs cmd check, moist (kept); leaves checked(moist).
- move check dry: "When you check on me while I am dry, I tell you I am dry."; needs cmd check, dry (kept); leaves checked(dry).
- move visitor waters: "A visitor has watered me; my soil is moist again."; needs dry, visitor; leaves moist.
- things it counts: moist; dry; cmd water; cmd check; done; checked; sun; visitor
